notes:
• The GM's projection follows the token selected on the canvas, a character's or an NPC's, and stays on it until another is selected. A player's is only ever their own character.
  • NPCs on the projection, as their own sheets have them. PF2e and SF2e: their rarity and traits under their name, the NPC sheet's tabs with its public and private notes, only the skills they have, and no experience, hero points or rest. D&D 5e: creature type and challenge rating, hit dice from the hit point formula, and legendary actions and resistance as tracks.
